text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Wow. That really is a ferocious lookin' monster...
You reckon we can defeat it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっぱり、
近くで見ると
凶悪なお顔やね……
ほんまに、
勝てるんやろか？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry!
We're invincible so long as we're together!
text_block_list.orig_text:
大丈夫さー！
　私たちが力を合わせれば、
怖いものなんかないさー！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
That we are!
What say we show this beast what we're capable of?
text_block_list.orig_text:
カオリの言う通りじゃ！
我らの絆の力、
とくと見せつけてやろうではないか！
